## Activity Code Report

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Target table | `BuildingIntelligence.RealProperty.ActivityCodeReport` |
| Script | `InfGold/Scripts/ActivityCodeReport.R` |
| Load type | Full reload |
| Grain | One row per project and detail activity code |
| Owner | TODO |
| Last reviewed | TODO |

Project cost report at activity-code level for CBRE project management
data. For each project and detail activity code it brings together the
budget, commitment, forecast and payment figures, calculates the variance
against the current budget, and attaches the project manager.

TODO: confirm and expand this description (intended use, who relies on it).

### Sources

- `CbreSilver.pjm_fact_project_activity` - budget, cost, invoice and payment amounts
- `CbreSilver.pjm_dim_project_activity` - activity code, type, parent code and description
- `CbreSilver.pjm_fact_project` - project status and phase
- `CbreSilver.pjm_dim_project` - project number and name
- `CbreSilver.pjm_fact_project_role` - project manager role assignments
- `CbreSilver.pjm_dim_project_role` - role names
- `CbreSilver.pjm_dim_contact` - project manager name and email

### Rules and filters

- Only activity codes with code type `detail`
- Where two or more detail codes share a project, parent code and characters 5-6 of the activity code, the one without characters 7-9 is dropped
- Rows where PreliminaryBudget, CurrentBudget, CurrentCommitted, Invoiced, Retained, Paid and Remaining are all zero are dropped
- Project manager is taken from role records whose source_unique_id matches `<digit>_project_manager`

### Consumers

- TODO main report or dashboard this table was built for

### Columns

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RefreshDate` | DATETIME2(3) | NOT NULL | Time the table was last reloaded |
| `ProjectSkey` | NVARCHAR(50) | NOT NULL |  |
| `ProjectNumber` | NVARCHAR(50) | NULL |  |
| `ProjectName` | NVARCHAR(255) | NULL |  |
| `ProjectStatus` | NVARCHAR(100) | NULL |  |
| `ProjectManager` | NVARCHAR(255) | NULL | First and last name of the project's manager |
| `ProjectManagerEmail` | NVARCHAR(255) | NULL |  |
| `ParentCode` | NVARCHAR(50) | NULL |  |
| `ActivityCode` | NVARCHAR(50) | NULL |  |
| `CodeType` | NVARCHAR(50) | NULL |  |
| `Description` | NVARCHAR(255) | NULL |  |
| `PreliminaryBudget` | DECIMAL(18,2) | NULL |  |
| `ApprovedBudget` | DECIMAL(18,2) | NULL |  |
| `Adjustments` | DECIMAL(18,2) | NULL |  |
| `ApprovedBudgetChanges` | DECIMAL(18,2) | NULL |  |
| `CurrentBudget` | DECIMAL(18,2) | NULL | ApprovedBudget + Adjustments + ApprovedBudgetChanges |
| `OriginalCommitted` | DECIMAL(18,2) | NULL |  |
| `ApprovedChanges` | DECIMAL(18,2) | NULL |  |
| `CurrentCommitted` | DECIMAL(18,2) | NULL |  |
| `PendingCommitments` | DECIMAL(18,2) | NULL |  |
| `PendingChanges` | DECIMAL(18,2) | NULL |  |
| `ProjectedExposure` | DECIMAL(18,2) | NULL |  |
| `AnticipatedFinalCost` | DECIMAL(18,2) | NULL | CurrentCommitted + ProjectedExposure |
| `Variance` | DECIMAL(18,2) | NULL | AnticipatedFinalCost - CurrentBudget |
| `VariancePercent` | DECIMAL(18,2) | NULL | Variance / CurrentBudget x 100; NULL where CurrentBudget is zero |
| `Invoiced` | DECIMAL(18,2) | NULL |  |
| `Retained` | DECIMAL(18,2) | NULL |  |
| `Paid` | DECIMAL(18,2) | NULL |  |
| `Remaining` | DECIMAL(18,2) | NULL |  |

### Notes

Each run builds the result in a temp table, then deletes all rows from the target and inserts the new rows inside one transaction, so a failed run leaves the previous data in place.

Gathers information on all real estate assets within the Real Property portfolio.
Covers location, name, and usage information on assets.
Assets are geolocated using the BC Address Geocoder as a quality check on the stored addresses.

TODO: confirm and expand this description (intended use, who relies on it).

- `CbreSilver.archibus_bl` - Archibus building information
- `CbreSilver.archibus_rm` - Archibus room information
- `CbreSilver.archibus_property` - Archibus property information
- `DATA_OWNER.RPD_LAND` - lat/lon information for properties

### Rules and filters

- Only active status buildings and properties
- Only actual properties, remove any internal dummy locations for financial processing

Project cost report at activity-code level for CBRE project management
data. For each project and detail activity code it brings together the
budget, commitment, forecast and payment figures, calculates the variance
against the current budget, and attaches the project manager.

TODO: confirm and expand this description (intended use, who relies on it).

### Sources

- `CbreSilver.pjm_fact_project_activity` - budget, cost, invoice and payment amounts
- `CbreSilver.pjm_dim_project_activity` - activity code, type, parent code and description
- `CbreSilver.pjm_fact_project` - project status and phase
- `CbreSilver.pjm_dim_project` - project number and name
- `CbreSilver.pjm_fact_project_role` - project manager role assignments
- `CbreSilver.pjm_dim_project_role` - role names
- `CbreSilver.pjm_dim_contact` - project manager name and email

### Rules and filters

- Only activity codes with code type `detail`
- Where two or more detail codes share a project, parent code and characters 5-6 of the activity code, the one without characters 7-9 is dropped
- Rows where PreliminaryBudget, CurrentBudget, CurrentCommitted, Invoiced, Retained, Paid and Remaining are all zero are dropped
- Project manager is taken from role records whose source_unique_id matches `<digit>_project_manager`
